name: Infinite Giga Jump Troll Tower
desc:
🎉 Welcome to Infinite Jump Troll Tower! Can you handle the chaos, the trolls, and the endless slaps while climbing to the top?
⬆️ Just tap the jump button endlessly to chain Infinite Jumps!

🕹️ How to Play:
🪤 Dodge tricky Troll Traps & survive random Slaps from other players.
🏆 Conquer the Tower to earn Cash, a legendary OP Slap Hand, and even a flying carpet.
😂 Troll your friends with wacky Tools and slap them straight into the Void.
🛒 Spend your Cash on stronger Troll Tools & unlock HD Admin. ✅ Everything you buy saves!


💻 Cross-Platform Fun:
Works on ALL PLATFORMS
✅ Tools & Admin saves are automatic.
